Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01564
⌈In case of P2 timeout occurrence after a reception has been successfully started (i.e.,
call to PduR_LinTpStartOfReception() has been called and returned BUFREQ_
OK), the LIN Interface shall abort the reception and request a schedule table change
to the applicative schedule by calling the function BswM_LinTp_RequestMode()
with the parameter LINTP_APPLICATIVE_SCHEDULE (see [SWS_LinIf_00646]). Af-
ter successful completion or failure (e.g., since some other schedule table change is
currently going on) of the schedule table switch, the LIN Interface shall notify the upper
layer by calling the function PduR_LinTpRxIndication() with the result E_NOT_
OK.⌋
